senses.gloss: (b. h.) to incline, waver, decline; to give way, bend. Y. Snh. X, 27ᵈ bot., v. infra. Tanḥ. B’har 1 כשתָּמוּט ידם לפני וכ׳ when their power shall sink before Nebuchadnezzar. Tanḥ. Vayishl. 3 (ref. to Prov. XXV, 26) כשמָט לפני וכ׳ when he bends (humiliates himself) before the wicked; Gen. R. s. 75 א״א לצדיק לָמוּט וכ׳ (Yalk. Gen. 130 לִימּוֹט) it is impossible to the righteous to bend &c.; a. e.
to be shaken, bent. Yalk. l. c., v. supra.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Zavim 3:3">Zab. III, 3</cite> <he>כל שאינה יכולה להָמִיט באדם</he> (not <he>בה אדם</he>) (Asheri <he>להָסִיט</he>, v. <cite ref="O00283"><he>סוּט</he></cite>) a ship which has no staggering effect on man. Gen. R. l. c. <he>מֵמִיט עצמו וכ׳</he> humbles himself.

senses.gloss: , Nithpol. נִתְמוֹטֵט to be declining; to sink. Y. Snh. X, 27ᵈ bot.; Yalk. Is. 338 (ref. to Is. LIV, 10) אם ראית זכות אבות שמָטָה … שנִתְמוֹטְטָה וכ׳ when thou seest the merit of the fathers decline and that of the mothers sink, go and cling to grace; Lev. R. s. 36, end שנִתְמֹטְטָה.—Y. l. c. 28ᵇ והיו מִתְמוֹטְטִין והולכין they sank deeper and deeper (into poverty).
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 71a:6">B. Mets. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>נכסיו מתמוטטין</he> (Ms. M. <he>מתמעטין</he>) his wealth will be reduced; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 665:3">Yalk. Ps. 665</cite> <he>מִתְמוֹטֵט</he> he will sink. B. Mets. l. c. <he>הללו מתמ׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. R. 2 <he>מוֹטְטִין</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes 2—4) these sink and rise again &c.; Yalk. l. c.
